accounts.name: source
docs: The Position's open Advance, when it has one.

accounts.name: source
docs: The Position's open Advance, when it has one.

instructions.name: begin_prize_payout_from_source
docs: A holder's prize Redeem on an EVM route: the Gemas burn, the shares are the bridge's to pay.

instructions.name: cancel_instant_redeem
docs: The seller takes the unsold Gemas back, any time before they are sold.

accounts.name: signer
docs: The seller on cancel; anyone on expiry.

accounts.name: owner_wallet
docs: when the order is finished.

accounts.name: request
docs: The Request the Offer had accepted, required exactly when it had one: it is listed again.

instructions.name: cancel_prize_payout_from_source
docs: The vault rejected a prize payout for good: Gemas and shares go back.

accounts.name: offer
docs: The Offer of a Backing Ticket: required to finish cancelling one, so the Offer is free again.

instructions.name: cash_in_fee
docs: Anyone: the covered Platform (0) or Studio (1) fee of a native or stake Source is paid to
its recipient.

instructions.name: cash_in_fee_from_source
docs: The EVM twin of `cash_in_fee`, signed by the chain's source authority (the bridge), which
pays the recipient on that chain.

instructions.name: claim_overflow
docs: Anyone moves up to `max` lines of an overflow record into the owner's stores; an empty
record is closed and its rent goes back to its payer. Source books are remaining accounts.

instructions.name: claim_spill
docs: Anyone moves up to `max` spill lines into the basket. Source books are remaining accounts.

instructions.name: close_match
docs: Closes a finished Match and returns the rents.

instructions.name: close_pair
docs: Returns the rent of an opener-to-joiner pair counter after its window.

instructions.name: close_season
docs: Releases what no rank took so it rolls into the next Season (anyone, once all is paid).

accounts.name: invite_gate
docs: until the admin first sets it, and no account means the gate is off. When the gate is on the
Invite key must also sign, passed as the first remaining account.

instructions.name: expire_instant_redeem
docs: Anyone returns the unsold Gemas of an expired order to its seller.

accounts.name: signer
docs: The seller on cancel; anyone on expiry.

accounts.name: owner_wallet
docs: when the order is finished.

accounts.name: request
docs: The Request the Offer had accepted, required exactly when it had one: it is listed again.

accounts.name: backer_protections
docs: Self-Excluded, anyone may withdraw their unused Offer at once.

accounts.name: pool
docs: The canonical sim_lst Pool, whose speedup times the yield.

accounts.name: extend_limit
docs: The owner's Extend Limit, created at the default on the first Extend.

accounts.name: extend_limit
docs: The owner's Extend Limit, created at the default on the first Extend.

instructions.name: fill_instant_redeem
docs: The fill authority buys all or part of an order at 75% of the value at fill.

accounts.name: owner_wallet
docs: when the order is finished.

instructions.name: fill_instant_redeem_from_source
docs: The bridge fills an order of an EVM-sourced Source against the vault's mirrored budget.

instructions.name: fund_treasury_stake
docs: Admin: tops up the Treasury with `shares` of the staking token (its own funding).

instructions.name: grow_store
docs: Anyone grows a basket or spill with their own lamports (a gift to its owner).

instructions.name: grow_store_sponsored
docs: The sponsor grows a basket or spill; needs the relayer's signature, within the caps.

instructions.name: harvest
docs: Anyone: the ready part of a Source's Leaderboard counter goes into the prize escrow.

instructions.name: init_ckpt_page
docs: Anyone pays for the next page of a class's checkpoint records.

instructions.name: init_ckpt_page_sponsored
docs: The same page, paid by the sponsor; needs the relayer's signature.

accounts.name: relayer
docs: Fronts the rent through the system program, and is made whole from the sponsor at once
(the runtime does not let a program credit a system account and then allocate it).

instructions.name: init_leaderboard
docs: Extends a Config that predates the Leaderboard, creates the pool Account and sets the fee.

instructions.name: init_native_custody
docs: Creates the shared native custody (vault + pool totals). Admin only, once.

accounts.name: pool
docs: The canonical sim_lst Pool: owned by the sim_lst program and at its `["pool"]` PDA.

instructions.name: init_source_book
docs: Anyone creates the book account of a Source.

instructions.name: init_sponsor
docs: Admin only: creates the sponsor that pays refundable rent for Players.

instructions.name: init_stores
docs: Creates the basket and spill of an Account that already exists. Anyone may pay.

instructions.name: init_treasury
docs: Creates the Treasury (config, Treasury Account, simSOL vault) or changes its fee rates.

instructions.name: init_treasury_stake
docs: Creates the Treasury without a simSOL vault (a deployment without `sim_lst`) or changes
its fee rates.

instructions.name: issue_prize_from_source
docs: The bridge issues the Pool's prize Source for shares an EVM vault confirmed in its escrow
(signed by the Season authority and the chain's source authority).

accounts.name: oracle
docs: Only for the oracle-priced path (no `OnchainPrice` for the asset).

instructions.name: join_match
docs: Joins an Open Match with an equal entry (backed with an accepted Offer in the optional
accounts).

accounts.name: offer
docs: The accepted Offer, when the entry is backed.

instructions.name: list_game
docs: Admin: lists a Game until a time for the build that hashes to `approved_hash` (or unlists
it with 0).

instructions.name: match_chunk
docs: Runs up to `max_steps` steps of a Settling or Refunding Match (anyone).

instructions.name: open_match
docs: Opens a Match for `game` at `entry`. `n` is the opener's next Match id; `pot` is a fresh
address (the entry is drawn here, into a new account of `pot_lines` lines at
`["ticket", funder, pot_nonce]`) or a complete Entry Ticket. With an accepted Offer in the
optional accounts, the Backer's Gemas fund the entry. `challenge` and `asset` are carried
in the Match record, since the id no longer encodes them.

accounts.name: offer
docs: The accepted Offer, when the entry is backed.

accounts.name: pool
docs: The canonical sim_lst Pool: owned by the sim_lst program and at its `["pool"]` PDA.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: Its Yield Fee is fixed on the Position at open.

instructions.name: open_stake_position
docs: Deposits `shares` of the active staking token into the shared vault as a new Position.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: Its Yield Fee is fixed on the Position at open.

accounts.name: owner
docs: The Account whose lines are staged: the Requester's own (Entry) or the Backer's (Backing).

accounts.name: offer
docs: The accepted Offer a Backing Ticket is for.

instructions.name: pay_season_rank
docs: Pays one (rank, budget line) step: every rank takes the same share of every line.

instructions.name: propose_game_change
docs: Proposes new settle authority and Studio terms; they apply 7 days later.

accounts.name: pool_spill
docs: here and are part of the budget.

instructions.name: redeem
docs: Redeems `amount` repaid Gemas of one line; pays the shares their yield was worth.

instructions.name: redeem_treasury
docs: The Treasury Account redeems Gemas it bought (an Instant Redeem fill); anyone may call it.

instructions.name: refresh_listing
docs: Anyone: moves the approved slot forward when the program's bytes still hash to the
approved build.

instructions.name: refund_match
docs: Starts refunding an Open or Active Match; the chunks follow.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the receipt's rent (refundable to it 14 days later).

accounts.name: opener_protections
docs: is on a Break or Self-Excluded, anyone may refund it at once.

instructions.name: register_game
docs: Registers a Game. Signed by the control of its program (upgrade authority, or the program's
`["tesoro-register"]` PDA once immutable). The Game id is the `game_program` account.

accounts.name: control
docs: The upgrade authority, or the Game program's `["tesoro-register"]` PDA once it is immutable.

instructions.name: request_instant_redeem
docs: Puts won Gemas into an order Tesoro fills; the repaid part is Redeemed at full value.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the order's rent: the holder, or with the sponsor accounts the relayer, made whole
from the sponsor at once (a Player with no SOL can still sell).

instructions.name: retire_native_custody
docs: Returns an old per-Position vault's simSOL to the Position owner and closes vault and custody.

instructions.name: return_own
docs: Returns `amount` of the owner's own Gemas of one line of the Source.

instructions.name: set_economy
docs: Admin: the Season keeper, the Instant Redeem fill keeper and its switch, and the routes a
recorded Season waits for.

instructions.name: set_entry_sizes
docs: Sets the entry sizes in Gemas (1 to 4, each a multiple of 100). Admin only.

instructions.name: set_invite_gate
docs: Admin only: turns the Invite gate on or off and sets the key that must co-sign
`create_account` while it is on.

instructions.name: set_onchain_price
docs: Admin: where an asset's Advances read their USD price on mainnet (a Pyth push feed).

instructions.name: set_oracle_lock
docs: Locks (mainnet) or unlocks the oracle's test-mode powers. Admin only.

instructions.name: set_prize_escrow
docs: Admin: switches a custody's prize escrow (off until the slashing fix is accepted).

instructions.name: set_prize_share
docs: Admin: the Pool's share of every Yield Fee realised from a Season announced ahead.

instructions.name: set_sponsor
docs: Admin only: the relayer key, the pause switch and the caps of the sponsor.

instructions.name: set_stake_apy_ceiling
docs: Admin: the ceiling on the annualised growth an Advance is sized on, in basis points.

instructions.name: set_stake_token
docs: Admin: the staking token new SOL Positions open with (creates its custody and vault the
first time). The stake pool account pins the token's Staking Rate source.

instructions.name: set_tesoro_studio
docs: Admin: the Account that receives the Studio Fee counters of Tesoro's own Games.

instructions.name: set_treasury_company
docs: Sets the company wallet that `withdraw_treasury` pays (admin).

instructions.name: settle_match
docs: Starts settling an Active Match (Game authority): freezes the outcome and the fees, writes
the receipt, emits the records. The payouts follow in `match_chunk`.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the receipt's rent (refundable to it 14 days later).

instructions.name: shrink_store
docs: The owner drops free slots; the sponsor is refunded first.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: Its Yield Fee sizes the Advance.

accounts.name: economy
docs: The Pool's share of the Yield Fee in force, snapshotted into the new Source (ticket 31).

instructions.name: take_advance_onchain
docs: `take_advance` priced from the asset's Pyth feed instead of a price the oracle names.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: Its Yield Fee sizes the Advance.

accounts.name: economy
docs: The Pool's share of the Yield Fee in force, snapshotted into the new Source (ticket 31).

accounts.name: pool
docs: The canonical sim_lst Pool, whose speedup times the yield.

accounts.name: economy
docs: The Pool's share of the Yield Fee in force, snapshotted into the new Source (ticket 31).

instructions.name: take_native_advance_onchain
docs: `take_native_advance` priced from the asset's Pyth feed instead of the keeper's price.

accounts.name: pool
docs: The canonical sim_lst Pool, whose speedup times the yield.

accounts.name: economy
docs: The Pool's share of the Yield Fee in force, snapshotted into the new Source (ticket 31).

instructions.name: take_stake_advance
docs: An Advance against a stake Position: Pyth price, sized on the pool's recent growth.

accounts.name: economy
docs: The Pool's share of the Yield Fee in force, snapshotted into the new Source (ticket 31).

instructions.name: void_season_rank
docs: Admin only, inside the 48-hour payout window: the rank pays nothing and its share stays in
the pool for the next season.

instructions.name: withdraw_treasury
docs: Withdraws `amount` SOL units of the Treasury balance to the company wallet (admin).

instructions.name: withdraw_treasury_stake
docs: Admin: withdraws the Treasury's spendable shares, in the token, to the company wallet.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: signer is not authorised

errors.name: GameNotRegistered
errors.msg: game is not registered

errors.name: GameRegistryFull
errors.msg: game registry is full

errors.name: InvalidAccount
errors.msg: account does not match

errors.name: BadRemainingAccounts
errors.msg: wrong number of remaining accounts

errors.name: DuplicateAccount
errors.msg: the same account was supplied twice

errors.name: NotWritable
errors.msg: account must be writable

errors.name: InvalidPool
errors.msg: pool is not the canonical sim_lst pool

errors.name: InvalidMint
errors.msg: mint is not the sim_lst pool's simSOL mint

errors.name: NativePosition
errors.msg: native Positions are opened and driven only by the native instructions

errors.name: NotNativePosition
errors.msg: position is not a native Position

errors.name: StalePrice
errors.msg: price is stale or not set

errors.name: BridgedSource
errors.msg: Gemas of an EVM-sourced Advance are redeemed through the bridge

errors.name: InvalidProfileName
errors.msg: a name is 3 to 20 letters, digits, spaces, dots, underscores or dashes, with no space at either end

errors.name: InvalidAvatar
errors.msg: avatar is not one of the available pictures

errors.name: EvmNotLinked
errors.msg: the EVM address is not linked to this Account through the bridge

errors.name: LeaderboardOff
errors.msg: the leaderboard is not set up

errors.name: TreasuryShort
errors.msg: the treasury cannot pay this instant redeem now

errors.name: SourceRequired
errors.msg: the open Advance's Source must be supplied

errors.name: CompanyNotSet
errors.msg: the Treasury has no company wallet set

errors.name: BadPriceFeed
errors.msg: the price feed account is not the mapped Pyth feed, or is not a verified price update

errors.name: PriceTooUncertain
errors.msg: the price feed's confidence interval is too wide to issue Gemas on

errors.name: OnchainPriceRequired
errors.msg: this asset is priced from its on-chain feed; use the on-chain Advance

errors.name: InviteRequired
errors.msg: creating an Account needs an Invite

errors.name: InviteKeyMissing
errors.msg: an Invite key is needed to turn the Invite gate on

errors.name: StakeTokenInactive
errors.msg: this staking token is not the one new Positions open with

errors.name: StakeCeilingNotSet
errors.msg: the Advance APY ceiling is not set

errors.name: NotStakePosition
errors.msg: position is not a staking-token Position

errors.name: BadStakePoolAccount
errors.msg: the stake pool account is not the custody's pool, is not owned by a stake pool program, or is not its token's pool

errors.name: OracleLocked
errors.msg: the oracle key can no longer register Positions, report yield or price Advances

errors.name: NotOldWorld
errors.msg: this account is not of the retired world, so it cannot be retired

errors.name: GameProofInvalid
errors.msg: the Game program is not a live program of a loader the registry understands

errors.name: NotGameControl
errors.msg: the signer does not control the Game program

errors.name: StudioFeeTooHigh
errors.msg: a Studio Fee is at most 10%

errors.name: StudioRecipientReserved
errors.msg: the Studio recipient may not be the Pool, the Treasury or the platform recipient

errors.name: NoPendingChange
errors.msg: no change is waiting for this Game

errors.name: ChangeDelayNotElapsed
errors.msg: a change to a Game applies 7 days after it is proposed

errors.name: GameNotListed
errors.msg: this Game is not listed, or was upgraded since the admin approved it

errors.name: PairLimitReached
errors.msg: these two Accounts have started too many Matches together today

errors.name: PairWindowOpen
errors.msg: this pair counter is still inside its 24-hour window

errors.name: CodeHashMismatch
errors.msg: the program's executable does not hash to the value given

errors.name: CodeChanged
errors.msg: the program's executable differs from the approved build; the admin must approve it again

errors.name: ListingCurrent
errors.msg: the listing already matches the program's deploy slot

errors.name: NotListed
errors.msg: the Game is not listed, so there is nothing to refresh

errors.name: ProgramTooLarge
errors.msg: the program is too large to hash in one transaction

errors.name: AdvanceBelowMinimum
errors.msg: the Advance would issue fewer Gemas than the minimum asked for (or the minimum is zero)

types.name: AccountCounters
docs: What an Account has counted: the id of its next Match, how many of its Matches are open, how
many Offers it has open. Created with the first Match or Offer; never closed.

fields.name: gemas
docs: Gemas minted by this Extend.

fields.name: horizon_months
docs: Horizon after the Extend.

types.name: AvatarChoice
docs: Which picture a Player shows. `Default` is the avatar derived from the Account key;
`NameService` is the avatar of the Player's .sol / .eth record (the app falls back to
`Default` when there is none).

types.name: BasketHead
docs: Head of a basket account: the `LineStore` header (`HEADER_LEN` bytes, byte 1 is the bump). The
lines follow in the same account.

fields.name: until
docs: When the Break ends (unix seconds).

types.name: BudgetLine
docs: One frozen line of a Season's budget.

fields.name: amount
docs: Gemas set aside for this Season's ranks. Never changes after `record`.

fields.name: paid
docs: Gemas paid out of it so far.

fields.name: oracle_authority
docs: Trusted for now to supply the issuance price and `YieldAccrued`/`PositionLocked` facts.
This is the seam for the LayerZero receiver (messages) and Pyth (price).

fields.name: platform_recipient
docs: `TesoroAccount` that receives the Platform Fee.

fields.name: legacy_games
docs: Unused since the per-Game records; its bytes stay so older accounts keep their layout.

fields.name: leaderboard_bps
docs: Leaderboard Fee in basis points of the Pot. Appended after `games`: an account created
before it reads the fields as zero (the unused tail of the account is zeroed) and is
extended by `init_leaderboard`.

fields.name: pool_account
docs: The Leaderboard Pool: `TesoroAccount` owned by the `["leaderboard"]` address. Zero until
`init_leaderboard`; the fee is off while it is.

fields.name: leaderboard_since
docs: Unix time `init_leaderboard` first ran: Matches opened before it were not charged the fee, so
readers show the fee only for Matches opened at or after it. Zero until then.

fields.name: entry_sizes
docs: Entry sizes in Gemas, zero-padded. All zero until `set_entry_sizes`: the default 500 /
1,000 / 2,500 apply, so an older Config needs no call. Appended after the Leaderboard
fields: an account created before reads them as zero from its zeroed tail.

fields.name: oracle_locked
docs: Set by the admin on mainnet (`set_oracle_lock`): the oracle key can no longer register
Positions, report their yield or name an Advance's price (test-mode paths), so a stolen
oracle key cannot mint Gemas. Appended last: an older Config reads it as false.

types.name: EconomyConfig
docs: Who may do what in the economy upgrade, as explicit settings (never the oracle authority).
Seeds `["economy"]`; created by the admin's `set_economy`.

fields.name: season_keeper
docs: Runs Seasons (`fund_season_prize`, `record_season`, `pay_season_rank`) besides the admin.

fields.name: fill_keeper
docs: May fill Instant Redeem orders while `keeper_fills` is on (the admin always may).

fields.name: keeper_fills
docs: Off by default: only the admin fills.

fields.name: pool_share
docs: The Pool's share of every realised Yield Fee, changeable from a Season announced ahead.

fields.name: routes
docs: Custodies whose prize escrow `record_season` waits for (zero = unused slot).

fields.name: tesoro_studio
docs: The Account that receives the Studio Fee counters of Tesoro's own Games (`cash_in_fee`);
zero until the admin names it.

types.name: EntryLimit
docs: The Gemas a Player may enter in one period. Zero is off.

fields.name: gemas
docs: The limit in force, before any due raise (zero = off).

fields.name: pending_gemas
docs: A raise waiting for `pending_at` (zero `pending_at` = none). A pending zero means "off".

fields.name: window_start
docs: When the current period began (zero = no entry counted yet) and the Gemas entered in it.

fields.name: gemas
docs: The limit in force after the change, in Gemas (zero = off).

fields.name: pending_gemas
docs: A raise waiting for `pending_at` (zero = none); a pending zero means the limit is removed.

fields.name: months
docs: The limit in force, before any due raise.

fields.name: pending_months
docs: A raise waiting for `pending_at` (zero = none).

fields.name: window_start
docs: When the current period began (zero = no Extend yet) and the months added in it.

fields.name: months
docs: The limit in force after the change.

fields.name: pending_months
docs: A raise waiting for `pending_at` (zero = none).

types.name: ExtendLimitState
docs: A Player's Extend Limit. Seeds `["extend_limit", account]`; created by the first Extend (at the
default) or by `set_extend_limit`, paid by the owner.

fields.name: account
docs: The `TesoroAccount` this limit belongs to; the default key until first used.

fields.name: class
docs: 0 Platform, 1 Studio.

fields.name: recipient
docs: The recipient's Tesoro Account.

fields.name: units
docs: What the shares were worth in the Source asset's units when paid (the bridge pays this
on the source chain).

types.name: GameRecord
docs: One Game. Registered once by whoever controls its program (see `registry`); changed only by
that same control, after `GAME_CHANGE_DELAY_SECS`. Listing is written by the admin.

fields.name: game
docs: The Game program's id.

fields.name: settle_authority
docs: Only this key may settle the Game's Matches (a PDA of the Game program, or a server key).

fields.name: studio_recipient
docs: `TesoroAccount` that receives the Studio Fee.

fields.name: pending_at
docs: Unix time a proposed change was made; zero while none is waiting.

fields.name: pending_by
docs: The control key that proposed it. Applying needs the same key to be in control still.

fields.name: listed_until
docs: The Game counts as listed until this unix time (admin). Zero: never listed.

fields.name: approved_slot
docs: The deploy slot the admin approved. A program upgraded since has a different slot and
counts as unlisted until the admin approves again.

fields.name: approved_hash
docs: SHA-256 of the approved build's executable bytes without trailing zeros (`registry::code_hash`).
A moved slot keeps the listing only through `refresh_listing`, which proves the bytes are these.

fields.name: listing_epoch
docs: Counts the builds the admin approved: bumped by `list_game` only when it sets a different
hash, never by `refresh_listing`. A Match remembers the epoch it opened under, so a moved
deploy slot with the same epoch is the same build.

fields.name: payout_shares
docs: Shares the Treasury paid the seller.

types.name: InstantOrderState
docs: An open Instant Redeem order (ticket 07's `InstantOrder` on chain): the unsold Gemas sit in
`line`, off the owner's basket, until a fill buys them, the owner cancels or the order expires.
Seeds `["instant", holder account, nonce LE]`; the owner pays the rent and gets it back, or the
sponsor does for a Player with no SOL (it is repaid first).

fields.name: account
docs: The seller's `TesoroAccount`.

fields.name: owner
docs: The seller's wallet.

fields.name: line
docs: `Line` bytes (`LINE_LEN`).

fields.name: payer
docs: Who paid the order's rent and gets it back at the close: the seller, or the sponsor's
relayer (then `sponsored_lamports` of it return to the sponsor first).

types.name: InstantRedeemed
docs: Won Gemas sold to the Treasury: `payout_units` is paid now (on Solana in the same transaction,
on an EVM chain by the vault's treasury through the bridge), `source_units` is their full value.

types.name: InviteGate
docs: While `required`, `create_account` needs `key` as an extra signer.

types.name: LineRef
docs: Names one line of a Source in an Account's basket or spill: the rest of its key is the Source.

fields.name: side
docs: 0 = the owner's own Gemas, 1 = won Gemas.

types.name: MatchChunkDone
docs: One chunk of a run did work. Stable ids: the Match id and the chunk number.

fields.name: blocked
docs: A step could not run (missing account or room); nothing was skipped.

fields.name: overflowed
docs: Credits this chunk wrote into overflow records instead of the Accounts' stores.

types.name: MatchId
docs: A Match id: the opener's Account and its counter value. Never reused: the counter only grows
and Accounts can't be closed and re-created.

types.name: MatchMeta
docs: What a Match carries explicitly now that the id is only a counter.

fields.name: listed
docs: The Game's listed status when the Match opened (an unlisted Game earns no Points).

fields.name: deploy_slot
docs: The Game program's deploy slot when the Match opened.

fields.name: deadline
docs: After this time anyone may refund the Match as abandoned (extendable, never past the
absolute deadline).

fields.name: deadline_abs
docs: Settlement must start before this; fixed at open.

fields.name: pot_lines
docs: Lines each side's Pot held when it was put in (the Pot never gains lines).

types.name: MatchRunStarted
docs: Settling or Refunding started: the outcome and the fees are frozen. Start record of a run.

fields.name: kind
docs: 0 win, 1 no-show, 2 draw, 3 cancelled, 4 abandoned, 5 game upgraded, 6 refunded by game.

fields.name: winner
docs: Index of the winning side (0 opened, 1 joined); 255 when there is none.

fields.name: a_share_bps
docs: Each side's Player share of a Backing, in bps (0 for an unbacked side).

types.name: MatchSettled
docs: The run is complete: every obligation is a durable basket or spill line.

types.name: MatchState
docs: A Match. The Pots (the Tickets' lines) live in the two Ticket accounts named in `pots`.

fields.name: listed
docs: The Game was listed when the Match opened: only then does a win earn Points.

fields.name: listing_epoch
docs: `GameRecord.listing_epoch` when the Match opened.

fields.name: payer
docs: Who paid the rent of this account; it goes back there when the Match is closed.

fields.name: pots
docs: The Ticket account that is each side's Pot (the default key until the side joined).

fields.name: room
docs: Slots held in Accounts' stores for the lines this Match will credit (`room_reserved` of
each spill counts them). Every credit that takes a new slot pays the holder's share down;
`close_match` hands back what is left.

types.name: MatchWon
docs: A Match was won. The Player is the Account that played (a Backer's win is the Player's for
points). Every season standing is the sum of these events, so anyone can recompute it. Written
by event-CPI when the outcome is frozen (the start of Settling), so it cannot be forged by
another program's log: readers check the program id of the inner instruction.

fields.name: opener
docs: The opener's Account and its counter value: the Match id.

fields.name: pool_fee
docs: Gemas this Match pays into the Leaderboard Pool.

fields.name: loser
docs: The Account that played on the losing side (the opponent of `player`).

types.name: NativeCustody
docs: The one custody of every native Position (ADR 0010): a single simSOL vault that keeps their
Principal, and the pool totals behind the Treasury's Yield Fee claim. Seeds `["native"]`; the
vault is `["native_vault"]` with this account as authority. Yield is never held here: it is
minted by `sim_lst` at the moment it is paid out.

fields.name: pool
docs: The canonical `sim_lst` Pool (test APY and speedup live there).

fields.name: vault
docs: Token account (PDA) that keeps the Principal of every Locked native Position.

fields.name: principal
docs: Principal of the Locked native Positions, SOL units (informational).

fields.name: route
docs: The Treasury's shares of this route: what it holds, what holders and the Pool are owed
(Yield Fees realised at cash-out), the prize escrow. Simulated shares are minted at payout,
so most of these are virtual until paid.

types.name: NativePayout
docs: simSOL paid to `to` for a native Position.

fields.name: kind
docs: 0 = redeem (yield minted), 1 = unlock Principal (from the vault), 2 = unlock free yield
(minted).

fields.name: player_share_bps
docs: Player's share of the surplus, basis points. The Backer's max loss is `entry`.

fields.name: expires_at
docs: Acceptance deadline for an Open Offer.

fields.name: use_by
docs: Deadline to enter a Match once Accepted.

fields.name: applicants
docs: Request keys of applicants (public Offers).

fields.name: ticket_open
docs: A Backing Ticket is staging this Offer's lines: it cannot be cancelled or expired until
the Ticket is cancelled or consumed.

types.name: OldAccountRetired
docs: An account of the world before the yield-by-math reset was closed by the admin. `kind`:
0 custody (`amount` = simSOL returned to its owner), 1 Position, 2 Source, 3 Holding
(`amount` 0), 4 Request, 5 Offer, 6 Treasury.

types.name: OnchainPrice
docs: Where an asset's Advances read their USD price on mainnet (ADR 0011): the Pyth sponsored push
feed account and the feed id it must carry. Admin-set, seeds `["onchain_price", source_asset]`.
While it exists the oracle-supplied price path (`take_advance`) is closed for that asset.

fields.name: asset
docs: The `source_asset` of the Positions it prices (the staking token's mint or EVM key).

fields.name: feed
docs: The `PriceUpdateV2` account the price is read from (owned by the Pyth receiver).

fields.name: feed_id
docs: The Pyth feed id of the asset's underlying coin (SOL/USD, ETH/USD, HYPE/USD).

fields.name: max_age_secs
docs: The oldest price an Advance accepts; the program caps it at `pyth::MAX_ONCHAIN_PRICE_AGE_SECS`.

fields.name: max_conf_bps
docs: The widest confidence interval an Advance accepts, share of the price in basis points.

types.name: OnchainPriceSet
docs: The admin mapped an asset to the Pyth feed its Advances are priced from.

types.name: OverflowClaimed
docs: Lines moved out of an overflow record into their owner's stores.

fields.name: left
docs: Lines still waiting in the record; zero means it was closed and its rent returned.

types.name: PairState
docs: How many Matches one opener-to-joiner pair has started in the current window.

fields.name: payer
docs: Who paid the counter's rent (the joiner's wallet); `close_pair` returns it there.

types.name: Party
docs: One entrant. `funder == player` unless the entry is Backed; then `share_bps` is the Player's
share of the surplus from the accepted Offer.

types.name: Phase
docs: A phase of a run. A Win is `Cuts(loser) -> Back(winner) -> Surplus`, a No-show is
`Cuts(0) -> Cuts(1) -> Back(0) -> Back(1)`, a refund is `Back(0) [-> Back(1)]`.

fields.name: base_rate
docs: Rate at `base_ts`, 1e9 fixed point (SOL per simSOL).

fields.name: speedup
docs: Yield-clock multiplier; 4,380 = 1 month of yield per 10 minutes.

types.name: PoolReservationsState
docs: The Pool's lines that Seasons have promised (`ledger::PoolReservations`). Seeds
`["pool_reservations"]`.

types.name: PoolShare
docs: The Pool's share of every realised Yield Fee, changeable only from a Season announced ahead.

fields.name: next_from
docs: First Season the pending change applies to; 0 = none pending.

types.name: Position
docs: A staker's locked, yield-bearing stake. `principal` is recorded but no function of this core
ever reads it except to size a new Advance, and none lets it reduce Debt.

fields.name: owner
docs: Account identity that owns the Position.

fields.name: principal
docs: Principal in source-asset base units.

fields.name: rate_bps
docs: Provider annual rate in basis points, fixed at open.

fields.name: advances
docs: Advances taken so far; also the index of the next Source.

fields.name: open_advance
docs: Index of the open Advance (the Source with Debt), if any.

fields.name: last_seq
docs: Highest cross-chain message sequence applied.

fields.name: cumulative_yield
docs: Last cumulative accrued yield applied, source-asset units.

fields.name: free_yield
docs: Yield accrued while no Advance had Debt to repay; belongs to the owner.

fields.name: opened_at
docs: Unix time the Position opened: Accrued Yield counts from here (ADR 0010). Native Positions
only; zero for Positions whose yield is reported.

fields.name: applied_net
docs: Native Positions: the yield checkpoint. Net Accrued Yield up to here is already settled:
consumed by closed Sources or banked in `free_yield`. The open Advance counts only what
accrues after it.

fields.name: custody_shares
docs: Native Positions: simSOL shares this Position holds in the shared custody vault.

fields.name: yield_fee_bps
docs: Native Positions: the Yield Fee in basis points, fixed at open (like `rate_bps`). A later
change of the Treasury's rate applies only to Positions opened afterwards.

fields.name: stake_rate_open
docs: Staking-token Positions (mainnet, ADR 0011): the pool's Staking Rate when the Position
opened, lamports per pool token at 1e12. Non-zero marks a stake Position; growth since open
is the Staking Rate now over this. Zero for every other Position.

fields.name: held_shares
docs: Staking-token shares (32 fractional bits) that the Position's Sources have landed and that
are not yet paid out or taken: the part of its custody that belongs to the holders of its
Gemas and to the owner's pocket. Economy upgrade (ticket 11).

fields.name: free_shares
docs: Shares (32 fractional bits) that are the owner's free yield: the owner's pocket of the
closed Sources and the yield that accrued while no Advance was open. Paid at Unlock
(native), claimable (reported Sources), or simply part of what Unlock leaves the owner
(staking token). Economy upgrade (ticket 11).

fields.name: paid_shares
docs: Staking-token Positions: whole shares already paid out of the custody before Unlock (to
holders by Redeem, to the prize escrow by harvest, to the Treasury by its own Redeem).
`custody_shares` stays what was deposited, so the pooled fee totals can be unwound exactly.

types.name: PositionUnlocked
docs: The seam for the `Unlock` message.

types.name: PriceFeed
docs: SOL/USD price used for issuance (micro-USD per whole SOL). Written by the oracle authority
for devnet; the Pyth seam replaces this account's source, not `take_native_advance`.

fields.name: lines
docs: The frozen budget, sorted by line key.

fields.name: cursor
docs: Per rank: how many budget lines it has been paid.

types.name: PrizeSource
docs: A prize Source: Gemas issued against a fixed quantity of escrowed shares. The Gemas count
never changes with the coin price; a holder of `k` Gemas redeems `k / gemas` of `shares`, so a
slash lowers every holder's coin value by the same ratio and the Source can never owe more
than it holds.

fields.name: shares
docs: Shares of the escrow this Source still owns (not counting pending payouts).

fields.name: gemas
docs: Prize Gemas outstanding (not counting pending payouts).

types.name: PrizeSourceState
docs: A prize Source: Gemas issued against a quantity of shares held in a route's prize escrow
(ticket 06's `PrizeSource`). It has no book and no unpaid Gemas. Seeds
`["prize", route, season LE]`.

fields.name: route
docs: The custody (route) whose escrow backs it.

types.name: Profile
docs: A Player's chosen display name and picture. Seeds `["profile", account]`; one per Account,
created by the first `set_profile`. Names are not unique and are not verified: a name is a label.

fields.name: account
docs: The `TesoroAccount` this Profile belongs to.

fields.name: name
docs: UTF-8 (ASCII only), zero padded past `name_len`.

fields.name: name_wallet
docs: A Solana wallet that co-signed `set_name_wallet`: its primary .sol name shows for this Player
(the Account's own wallet is a Tesoro-created one with no name). Default key = none.

fields.name: name_evm
docs: An EVM address linked to this Account through the bridge (`link_evm`) and attached by
`set_name_evm`: its primary .eth name shows. All zeros = none.

fields.name: break_until
docs: A Break: no Match entries, Requests, Offers or being backed until this time.

fields.name: self_exclusion_until
docs: A Self-Exclusion: all of a Break, plus no Advances or Extends, until this time.

types.name: ProtectionsState
docs: A Player's Protections. Seeds `["protections", account]`; created by the first
`set_entry_limit` (or any later Protection), paid by the owner. A Player who never set one has no
account, which means no Protection is in force: every Match entry and Backing still passes the
(empty) PDA address, so a direct transaction cannot leave it out.

fields.name: account
docs: The `TesoroAccount` these belong to; the default key until first used.

types.name: Receipt
docs: The settlement receipt written when the Match enters Settling or Refunding: the outcome is
frozen in core from then on. Tables read its existence as proof their result slot is spent.

types.name: Redeemed
docs: The seam for `PayYield`: source-chain units owed to the redeeming Account's address there.

types.name: Request
docs: A Player's listing asking to be backed for a game and entry size. Carries no split.

types.name: ReservationEntry
docs: One reservation of a Pool line by a recorded Season's budget (Borsh form of
`ledger::PoolReservations`' entries).

types.name: RoomHold
docs: Slots of one Account's stores held for a Match.

fields.name: treasury_shares
docs: Shares the Treasury holds, including everything it owes.

fields.name: escrow_enabled
docs: The prize escrow ships switched off until the slashing fix lands (decisions.md, D1).

fields.name: last_funded
docs: Last Season whose prize was funded on this route (0 = none). Strictly increasing.

fields.name: pool_realised_total
docs: Lifetime Pool halves of realised Yield Fees; `== pool_owed + pool_funded_total`.

fields.name: pool_funded_total
docs: Lifetime shares moved from `pool_owed` into the escrow.

types.name: Run
docs: The frozen plan and its cursor. Fixed size: it does not grow with the Pot, so the Match record
stays one small account whatever the number of lines. Which line a fee is cut from is not
listed up front: the cut walks the loser's Pot lines in order from the cursor, which only moves
forward, so a replayed or interleaved chunk continues exactly where the last one stopped.

fields.name: fees
docs: Platform, Studio, Leaderboard totals in Gemas (a No-show: Platform only, both sides).

fields.name: cut_left
docs: Fee Gemas still to cut from each side's lines, per class.

fields.name: player_left
docs: Gemas of the surplus still owed to the Player (Backed winner), frozen at the start.

types.name: SeasonState
docs: A recorded Season: the ranking, the frozen prize budget and the per-rank payout cursors, with
the 48-hour payout window. Created by `record_season`, paid by `pay_season_rank` one
(rank, budget line) step at a time. Seeds `["season", number as u32 LE]`.

types.name: SeasonWindow
docs: The payout window of a recorded Season (ADR 0012), kept beside the `Season` so that Seasons
recorded before the window existed keep their layout. Created by the same `record_season`.

fields.name: recorded_at
docs: Unix seconds `record_season` ran.

fields.name: voided_mask
docs: Bit `i` set once rank `i` was voided: it pays nothing and its share stays in the pool.

fields.name: until
docs: When the Self-Exclusion ends (unix seconds).

types.name: SettlementReceipt
docs: Written when a Match enters Settling or Refunding: proof, in core, that its outcome is frozen
and its table's result slot is spent. Refundable to whoever paid it.

types.name: Source
docs: The Advance a Gema was issued from.

fields.name: owner
docs: Owner of the Position at issuance; Gemas of this Source are "own-sourced" for them.

fields.name: unit_num
docs: Source-asset base units per Gema is `unit_num / unit_den`.

fields.name: yield_units
docs: Accrued yield applied to this Source, source-asset units.

fields.name: redeemed_units
docs: Source-asset units already paid out by Redeem.

fields.name: due_at
docs: Planned repayment date of the Source's Gemas (unix seconds), set by the instruction layer
when the Advance is taken and moved by Extend: the fast-first key of its basket lines.

fields.name: yield_fee_bps
docs: Yield Fee charged when this Source's Gemas are cashed out, fixed when the Advance opens
(ticket 31). Fee-class lines are exempt whatever this says.

fields.name: pool_bps
docs: The Pool's share of that fee, fixed when the Advance opens (red-team #10).

fields.name: fee_units
docs: Source-asset units of Yield Fee charged on this Source's cash-outs, cumulative (included in
`redeemed_units`). The bridge reads its delta to tell an EVM vault what to keep.

fields.name: pool_units
docs: Units of those cash-outs owed to the Leaderboard Pool, cumulative: its part of the Yield
Fee and, on the Treasury's redeems, its fifth of the Instant fee.

types.name: SourceAuthority
docs: The signer allowed to report `PositionLocked` / `YieldAccrued` for Positions of one source
chain (the cross-chain bridge PDA). Registered by the admin; seeds `["source_auth", chain_byte]`.

types.name: SourceBookHead
docs: Head of a Source's book account.

fields.name: source
docs: The `SourceState` address this book belongs to.

types.name: SpillHead
docs: Head of a spill account, same format as [`BasketHead`].

types.name: SponsorState
docs: What the program pays for Players and Sources, and the limits on it (spec "Capacity and
sponsored rent"). The account also holds the lamports it pays out: anyone may send SOL to it.

fields.name: relayer
docs: Only this key's signature authorises sponsored growth and sponsored pages.

fields.name: paused
docs: While set, nothing is sponsored (Players pay for themselves).

fields.name: per_account_cap
docs: Most sponsored (refundable) rent one Account's basket and spill may hold together.

fields.name: total_cap
docs: Most sponsored refundable rent outstanding over all Accounts.

fields.name: outstanding
docs: Sponsored refundable rent outstanding now (all baskets and spills).

fields.name: pages_cap
docs: Most the sponsor may spend, over time, on checkpoint pages (never refunded).

types.name: StakeConfig
docs: The staking-token setting for mainnet SOL Positions (ADR 0011): which token new Positions open
with, and the ceiling on the APY an Advance is sized on. Seeds `["stake_config"]`. Test mode
never creates it.

fields.name: active_mint
docs: Mint of the one active token; default = none yet.

fields.name: apy_ceiling_bps
docs: Ceiling on the annualised growth an Advance is sized on, basis points; 0 = not set (no
Advance can be taken).

types.name: StakeCustody
docs: The shared custody of one staking token. Every stake Position of that token holds its
`custody_shares` in `vault`. Seeds `["stake_custody", mint]`; the vault is a token account
at `["stake_vault", mint]` with this account as authority.

fields.name: pool
docs: The SPL stake pool account the token's Staking Rate is read from.

fields.name: principal
docs: Principal of the Locked stake Positions, lamports (informational).

fields.name: refilled_shares
docs: Tokens the Treasury bought back by redeeming Gemas (their yield stays in the vault).

fields.name: instant_shares
docs: Tokens paid by Instant Redeem, cumulative.

fields.name: withdrawn_shares
docs: Tokens withdrawn to the company wallet, cumulative.

fields.name: route
docs: The Treasury's shares of this route. The vault holds exactly the open Positions' custody
plus `route.treasury_shares` plus the prize escrow (`route.escrow_total()`).

types.name: StakePayout
docs: Staking tokens paid to `to` for a stake Position or from the Treasury.

fields.name: kind
docs: 0 = redeem, 1 = unlock Principal, 2 = unlock free yield, 3 = instant redeem, 4 = withdrawal.

fields.name: rate
docs: Staking Rate at open, lamports per token at 1e12.

types.name: StakeTokenSet
docs: The admin chose the staking token new SOL Positions open with.

types.name: StoreKind
docs: Which of an Account's two stores an instruction acts on.

types.name: Terms
docs: Fee terms snapshotted when the Match opened. The Leaderboard Fee is read when settling starts.

fields.name: studio_owner
docs: `None`: Tesoro's own Studio Fee, a Source counter. `Some(account)`: an outside studio,
paid as a fee line in its basket.

fields.name: studio_priority
docs: The Game was listed when the Match opened: its Studio Fee is a senior fee class, repaid
right after the Platform Fee. Otherwise it is paid as ordinary won Gemas into the
recipient's basket (`studio_owner` must then be set).

fields.name: authority
docs: Solana wallet that controls the Account.

fields.name: evm_address
docs: The EVM family address of the Account (zero until set).

types.name: TicketHead
docs: The zero-copy head: a plain byte array (alignment 1, no padding) that gives Anchor the
discriminator and owner check.

types.name: TicketKindArg
docs: Which Ticket to open.

types.name: Treasury
docs: Tesoro's Treasury (CONTEXT.md). Its Yield Fee is taken when yield is cashed out (ticket 31) and
kept as the route's shares (`NativeCustody.route`; native shares are minted lazily). It pays
Solana Instant Redeems and `withdraw_treasury` from `vault` first, then by minting the
shortfall out of its route's virtual shares, and holds the Gemas it bought in `account`, a
`TesoroAccount` whose authority is this PDA. Seeds `["treasury"]`. Its fee rates apply on every
chain: each new Source keeps `yield_fee_bps` as its cash-out fee.

fields.name: yield_fee_bps
docs: Yield Fee, basis points of yield cashed out (2,000 at launch).

fields.name: instant_fee_bps
docs: Instant Redeem Fee, basis points of the redeemed Gemas' value (3,500 on devnet; 2,500 on mainnet, ADR 0011).

fields.name: account
docs: The Treasury Account (`["account", treasury]`).

fields.name: vault
docs: simSOL token account (`["treasury_vault"]`), authority = this PDA.

fields.name: instant_units
docs: SOL units paid out by Solana Instant Redeems, cumulative.

fields.name: funded_shares
docs: simSOL shares the admin funded the vault with, cumulative.

fields.name: withdrawn_units
docs: SOL units withdrawn to the company wallet, cumulative.

fields.name: company
docs: The wallet whose simSOL account `withdraw_treasury` pays; unset (default) refuses.

types.name: TreasuryWithdrawn
docs: The admin withdrew `units` SOL (`shares` simSOL, `minted_units` of it freshly minted from the
earned Yield Fee) to the company wallet.

types.name: UnlockShortfall
docs: A stake Unlock found the custody short of the owner's Principal and free yield (holders' landed
shares grew with the pool). The Treasury topped up what it could spend; `gap_shares` is what
the owner did not get (founder, 2026-10-22: Tesoro covers it; Unlock never fails).

types.name: YieldConfig
docs: The authority allowed to mint simulated yield.
